app.name: Smart Student Assistance Portal
app.tagline: One Portal. Every Scholarship, Exam & Opportunity.
app.subtagline: AI-powered, multilingual assistance for every Indian student — scholarships, exams, documents and nearby offices, all in your language.

landing.challenge1Body: Scholarships and schemes live across dozens of government websites that students can't navigate.
landing.challenge2Body: Students can't tell which schemes they actually qualify for, so they miss out on funding.
landing.challenge3Body: Complex paperwork and office visits discourage students from applying at all.
landing.challenge4Body: Exams, hackathons and olympiads go unnoticed without a single place to track them.
landing.feature1Body: We score every scheme against your age, category, class, income and state — instantly.
landing.feature2Body: See exactly which documents you're missing and find the nearest office that issues them.
landing.feature3Body: Track entrance exams, hackathons and deadlines with reminders 7/3/1 days before.
landing.step1Body: Tell us about yourself and ask the AI assistant anything in your language.
landing.step2Body: We match you to schemes and exams and alert you before deadlines.
landing.step3Body: Follow step-by-step document guides, then apply on the official portal.
landing.trustNote: Scheme data is modeled on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP), myScheme, AICTE, UGC, DST and state scholarship portals — so what you see here is what you can verify on the official site.
landing.feature4Body: Ask anything in your own language — the assistant explains schemes, documents and next steps across 20+ intents, with an optional OpenAI/Gemini upgrade.
landing.feature5Body: 68 real entrance and competitive exams — JEE, NEET, CUET, UPSC, SSC, CAT and state CETs — with phase-wise roadmaps, free resources and mock tests.
landing.feature6Body: Smart India Hackathon, TCS CodeVita, national olympiads, robot contests and science fairs — every deadline and prize in one timeline.
landing.feature7Body: 140 curated resources from NCERT, DIKSHA, SWAYAM, NPTEL and SATHEE — notes, videos, previous-year papers and mocks in 7 languages.
landing.feature8Body: 10 step-by-step document guides — income, caste, domicile, UDID and more — that show exactly what is missing before you apply.
landing.feature9Body: An interactive map of 150 tehsil, CSC, e-Seva and collectorate offices with addresses, timings and the services each office offers.
landing.catTitle: Find schemes for every kind of student
landing.step4Body: Apply on the official portal, then track deadlines, renewals, document gaps and payment status from one dashboard.
landing.engineTitle: How the Eligibility Engine scores you
landing.engineBody: Every scheme is scored against your profile on six checks — age, gender, category, class level, income and domicile. Your match percentage maps to a clear verdict:
landing.statusEligibleBody: 80–100% match — you clear every check. Apply now.
landing.statusActionBody: 50–79% match — one or two documents or details are pending.
landing.statusNotBody: Below 50% — key criteria do not match yet.
landing.langTitle: Built for every corner of India
landing.langBody: SSAP works fully in 7 languages — the interface, scheme names and the AI assistant switch together, so no student is left behind.
landing.story1Quote: I found the merit-cum-means scholarship I never knew existed. The eligibility engine matched me in seconds and told me exactly which document was missing.
landing.story2Quote: The CUET exam roadmap and deadline alerts kept me on track. My parents finally understood how we would pay for college.
landing.story3Quote: I applied in Hindi with the AI assistant on my phone and tracked everything. ₹12,000 was credited straight to my bank via DBT.
landing.why1Body: A 8px design grid, WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation and large tap targets — great on a ₹7,000 phone too.
landing.why2Body: A 20-intent rule engine answers in 7 Indian languages out of the box, with an optional LLM upgrade.
landing.why3Body: A cron engine watches every scheme and exam date and pushes in-app alerts 7, 3 and 1 day before closing.
landing.why4Body: Every scheme links to its official portal — NSP, myScheme, MahaDBT, UP Scholarship and more — so trust is one click away.
landing.faq1A: Yes — 100% free. SSAP never charges students; it only helps you discover official schemes and guides you to the government portal to apply.
landing.faq2Q: How does the eligibility matching work?
landing.faq2A: Six checks — age, gender, category, class level, family income and domicile state — are scored against each scheme. 80%+ means Eligible, 50–79% means Action Needed, below 50% means Not Eligible.
landing.faq3Q: Is the scheme data real and official?
landing.faq3A: Yes. The catalogue is modeled on the National Scholarship Portal, myScheme (5,000+ GoI schemes), AICTE, UGC and state portals, and every scheme links out to its official application site.
landing.faq4A: English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and Gujarati — switch any time with the 🌐 button; the assistant follows your language too.
landing.faq5Q: Does SSAP apply on my behalf?
landing.faq5A: No. Applications always happen on the official government portal — SSAP prepares you with eligibility, document checklists, step-by-step guides and direct links.
landing.faq6A: A background job checks every scheme and exam you follow and raises in-app notifications 7, 3 and 1 day before the deadline, plus “closing soon” badges in your dashboard.
landing.ctaSub: Create your free profile and see your eligible schemes in 30 seconds.

offices.title: Nearby Citizen Offices
offices.locationDenied: Location access blocked — pick your state instead.
offices.empty: No offices found for this filter.
offices.hintNonCreamy: Non-Creamy Layer certificate is issued by the Tehsildar / Mandal Revenue Office for OBC students.
offices.hintValidity: Caste Validity is verified by the Tehsildar / District Office along with your caste certificate.
offices.hintBank: Any bank branch near you issues a student passbook — CSCs can also help open/seed accounts.
offices.hintBonafide: A Bonafide Certificate is issued by your school or college office — not a government office.
offices.hintUdid: UDID (disability) cards are issued via CSCs or the Unique Identification Authority of India (www.disabilityaffairs.gov.in).
offices.hintMinority: Minority certificates are issued by the District Minorities Welfare Office / Collectorate.
offices.hintSchool: Mark sheets and school records are issued by your own school/college — collect them from the institution office.
offices.hintAffidavit: An affidavit is drafted on stamp paper and attested by a Notary Public or gazetted officer.
offices.hintExam: Entrance test scorecards are issued online by the exam body (NTA, UPSC, ICAI, etc.) — download from the official exam website.
